zh.title: 阿爾及利亞派四架Su-30戰機與加油機前往尼亞美
zh.summary: 阿爾及利亞部署四架Su-30戰機與伊爾-78加油機至尼亞美；支援尼日軍方
body: 阿爾及利亞於2026年8月30日部署四架Su-30戰鬥機與一架伊爾-78空中加油機至尼日首都尼亞美（NIM）。阿爾及利亞國防部指出，兩個Su-30巡邏編隊於當晨降落於尼亞美機場，尼日總理澤恩（Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine）到場接機。
此項部署係應尼日當局請求，由阿爾及利亞總統特本（Abdelmadjid Tebboune）指示並由參謀總長香格里拉（Said Chanegriha）下令執行。此前於8月29日，叛亂士兵襲擊尼日軍事基地與總統府，位於迪奧里·哈馬尼國際機場（NIM）園區內的第101空軍基地傳出槍響與爆炸。

en.title: Algeria deploys four Su-30 fighters and Il-78 tanker to Niamey
en.summary: Algeria deploys four Su-30 fighters and an Il-78 tanker to Niamey following a military airbase attack.
body: Algeria deployed four Sukhoi Su-30 fighter aircraft and an Ilyushin Il-78 aerial refueling tanker to Niamey on August 30, 2026. According to the Algerian Ministry of National Defense (MDN), two Su-30 patrols landed at Niamey airport that morning alongside the tanker aircraft. Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine met the arriving Algerian flight on arrival.

The deployment responded to an official request from Nigerien authorities following an attack on August 29, 2026, when mutinous soldiers targeted Niger's main military airbase and the presidency. Gunfire and explosions occurred around the presidency and Air Base 101, located inside the Diori Hamani International Airport (NIM) complex. The mission was instructed by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune and ordered by General Said Chanegriha.

zh.title: 英軍A400M運輸機降落北極島嶼運送美英陸戰隊
zh.summary: 英國空軍A400M運輸機運送美英陸戰隊與戰術車降落挪威揚馬延島。
body: 英國皇家空軍（RAF）一架空中巴士A400M運輸機於2026年8月29日降落於挪威北極偏遠島嶼揚馬延島，運送美軍與英軍皇家海軍陸戰隊隊員，以及兩輛聯合輕型戰術車（JLTV）。此次任務由來自布萊茲諾頓皇家空軍基地的第LXX中隊執行，屬於「大西洋城26」行動（Operation Atlantic City 26）的一部分。
該行動自2026年8月26日持續至9月4日，是在北約「北極哨兵」加強警戒活動下，由挪威主導、美英三國共同參與的聯合活動。揚馬延島距離挪威本土約1000公里，並無港口而僅有近海錨地。島上唯一的未鋪設砂礫跑道揚馬延斯菲爾德（ENJA）是將重型裝備與車輛直接運送登島的唯一可行途徑。

en.title: RAF A400M Transport Lands US and UK Marines on Remote Arctic Island
en.summary: RAF transport aircraft delivers multinational marines and tactical vehicles to Jan Mayen island.
body: A Royal Air Force Airbus A400M Atlas transport aircraft landed on the remote Norwegian Arctic island of Jan Mayen on August 29, 2026. The aircraft delivered US Marines, UK Royal Marines, and two Joint Light Tactical Vehicles (JLTVs) to the island, which is located north of the Greenland-Iceland-UK (GIUK) gap. The deployment was conducted by LXX Squadron from RAF Brize Norton (RAF) as part of Operation Atlantic City 26.

Operating from August 26 to September 4, 2026, the operation is a Norwegian-led trilateral activity with the United Kingdom and the United States under NATO's enhanced vigilance activity, Arctic Sentry. Because Jan Mayen has no port and only offshore anchorages, the single unpaved gravel runway at Jan Mayensfield (ENJA) serves as the only practical route for delivering heavy vehicles and equipment directly to the island.

zh.title: euroAtlantic新執行長掌舵 推進雙機隊與長程ACMI佈局
zh.summary: euroAtlantic任命新執行長；推進雙機隊與長程濕租業務
body: 總部位於里斯本的euroAtlantic Airways於2026年5月任命Pauls Calitis出任執行長。Calitis先前在總部位於里加的airBaltic擔任營運長及執行董事會成員，並曾短暫擔任該公司代理執行長。euroAtlantic於2024年由私募股權投資公司Njord Partners取得完整控制權。
euroAtlantic專注於長程廣體飛機ACMI與包機租賃業務，並與子公司STP Airlines合作營運里斯本往返聖多美和普林西比的定期航線。該公司於2025年底引進首架空中巴士A330-200，打破以往僅使用波音機隊的傳統，正式開展雙機隊營運策略。

en.title: euroAtlantic Airways Names Pauls Calitis CEO Amid Dual-Fleet Expansion
en.summary: euroAtlantic Airways appoints Pauls Calitis as CEO while advancing its dual-fleet widebody ACMI operations.
body: Headquartered in Lisbon, euroAtlantic Airways appointed Pauls Calitis as its Chief Executive Officer in May 2026. Calitis previously served as Chief Operating Officer and interim Chief Executive Officer at Riga-based airBaltic before joining euroAtlantic. The airline was fully acquired by private equity firm Njord Partners in 2024.

euroAtlantic specializes in long-haul widebody ACMI charter operations and also operates scheduled flights between Lisbon and São Tomé and Príncipe with subsidiary STP Airlines. The carrier introduced its first Airbus A330-200 in late 2025, transitioning away from a traditional Boeing-only operator to a dual-fleet strategy.
